comment: Fillet's Full Round (mitcad#2279), tools/ui-fillet-full-round-test.sh: a block 20 x 30 x 30 (F1.b0; its top F1:top at z 30, the side F1:side3 at x 0, F1:side1 at x 20) whose top's edge at x 20 is bevelled by 4 (Chamfer1, F2). The top, 16 wide, lies between the vertical side and the bevel; its full round has radius 16 / sqrt(2).
